LESSON: READING 2.2.1 READING FOR COMPREHENSION: POETRY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, part of Strand 2 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why are poems important? 2. How can we get specific details from a poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read poems based on the theme,

2. work with peers to identify the main ideas in the poems,

3. develop a vocabulary bank of words related to the theme from the poems,

4. identify features of style used in the poem (e.g. rhyme, metaphors, similes, repetition)

5. discuss the themes in a poem and relate them to real life,

6. work jointly to compose a simple poem on the theme,

7. organise their best poems in the class portfolio,

8. stage choral verses on the poems during inter-class festivals or clubs. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read poems based on the theme,
2. work with peers to identify the main ideas in the poems,
3. develop a vocabulary bank of words related to the theme from the poems,
4. identify features of style used in the poem (e.g. rhyme, metaphors, similes, repetition)
5. discuss the themes in a poem and relate them to real life,
6. work jointly to compose a simple poem on the theme,
7. organise their best poems in the class portfolio,
8. stage choral verses on the poems during inter-class festivals or clubs. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: This is enhanced as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creative thinking when

working jointly with peers to compose a simple poem on the theme.

• Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner effectively orders and prioritises tasks when developing a vocabulary bank on

words related to the theme from the poems.

Values:
• Unity: This is promoted as the learner cooperates with peers to stage a choral verse on the poem during inter-class festivals

or clubs.

• Respect: It is enhanced as the learner appreciates diverse opinions when discussing the themes in a poem and relating them

to real life.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Information Technology: This is promoted as the learner works with peers to compose and stage their choral verses (poems)

on cyber security during inter-class festivals or clubs.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of poetry to their learning of poems for performance in Creative Arts and Sports.
